footprints.description: TE SEC II power card edge connector 1761500, 26 contacts (13 per face: 3 triple-post power + 10 single), straddle mount
footprints.note: Drawing 1761500 (Tyco 108-2202), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/1761500.pdf, sheet 2 'recommended PC board layout for connector mounting, typ both sides' and sheet 1. Straddle mount: the housing sits on the board edge, pads on BOTH faces (pins 1..13 on the part's own face, pins 14..26 on the opposite face, carrying opposite = true; edgeMount). Board edge: y = +6.225 (the housing is 15.49 deep, y -7.745..+7.745, and the board edge datum N is 13.97 from the card-entry face: -7.745 + 13.97); the board lies at +y of that edge, so pads run from the edge to 6.35 (printed 6.35 MIN) = centre y 9.4; the card-entry face is at -y. 19 pad positions per face at 2.54 (18 spaces = 45.72 printed), 1.27 wide (printed 1.27 +-0.05): 3 power contacts of 3 posts each (the 9 left posts, 7.62 between contact centres as printed: 2X 7.62) then 10 single contacts (9X 2.54 = 22.86 printed); every post of a contact is a pad with the contact's pin number. Pin numbering is NOT printed on the layout: only the mating card's pads 14..26 are named (pad 26 = leftmost wide pad, pad 14 = rightmost single). Assumed: the opposite face is numbered the same way, pad n directly across the board from pad n+13 (pins 1..13 own face, 14..26 opposite face), and numbering runs from the right end (single pads) to the wide pads on both faces. Ear holes 3.68 dia, 62.87 apart (+-31.435), 1.65 above the board edge (5.75 - 4.11 = 1.64 printed arithmetic): y = 6.225 - 1.65 = 4.575, drawn non-plated (plating not printed). Body 69.72 x 15.49 printed (overall incl. ears). The board edge is the line y = +6.225 across the pads; the housing straddles it.

Top row pads 64..33 left to right, bottom row pads 1..32 left to right (printed PAD labels); in this footprint the top row (pins 33..64) is the row nearer the card entry, as the layout is drawn - the print does not say which edge of the layout is the card entry and its section view suggests the upper contacts (pins 33..64) have the farther tails, so the two rows may be swapped. Right-angle through hole: card entry at -y (assumed; not shown on the hole layout), board plane = x/y. Row positions along the card-insertion axis follow the section/plan prints: the nearer row of tails is 15.80 behind the card-entry face (15.80 REF on 5645384; same housing family), the other 3.81 further (rows 3.81 printed); housing depth 15.49 (y -7.745..+7.745) so the rows are at y = 15.80 - 7.745 = +8.055 and +11.865 (measured on the plan view, not printed as a dimension).
